questions.q: What does s.shift(1) do to a daily Series?
options: Each date gets the value of the previous day
Each date gets the value of the next day
why: Correct. The values move one step later in time. The first row becomes NaN.
It keeps all rows and puts NaN in the first one.

questions.q: You predict sales for day t. Which feature leaks the answer?
why: Correct. The window ends at day t, so it contains the value you want to predict.
The shift moves the window to days t−7 to t−1. It is safe.

questions.q: Minute-level server request counts must become hourly totals. Which call?
why: Correct. Totals are sums over each hour.
A mean gives requests per minute, not per hour.
That adds all days together for each hour of day, which is a different result.

questions.q: You want a profile of average demand for Monday ... Sunday from 6 months of daily data. Which call?
why: Correct. It averages all Mondays together, all Tuesdays together, and so on.
That gives one value per week, not per weekday.
That gives a smooth line over time, not 7 weekday values.
